=== Marriage ===
On March 30, 1862, Lucy married Calvin Harrison in Osage County, Missouri.<ref>"Missouri, County Marriage, Naturalization, and Court Records, 1800-1991," database with images,  (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6XNF-CBBY : 4 August 2022), Lucy Ann Glascow in entry for Calvin Harris, 30 Mar 1862; citing Marriage, Osage, Missouri, United States, Missouri State Archives, Jefferson City; FHL microfilm 007513950.</ref>

=== Death ===
Lucy died on April 18, 1919 in Osage County, Missouri at the home of Andrew and Sarah Ellen Harrison due to complications from influenza.<ref>Missouri Death Certificates;
